bands.label: Sparse
bands.description: Widely spaced trees suitable for pastoral grazing, orchard fringes, or enrichment planting.

bands.label: Agroforestry
bands.description: Integrated tree and crop density balancing canopy shade with understory cultivation.

bands.label: Standard
bands.description: Conventional afforestation density for canopy formation and soil stabilization.

bands.label: Dense
bands.description: High density planting requiring subsequent thinning or suitable for protective shelterbelts.

bands.label: Very Dense
bands.description: Ultra-dense planting such as Miyawaki urban groves with high seedling competition.

baseline_rate_provenance: A common rule of thumb used here as an Assumption. Source to be confirmed.
